text.tspan: LOWER JOINT CONCEPT / CLOSE STRING FORCES THROUGH THE FRAME
Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
Shoe and joint zones are symbolic. Vessel cradle is shown separately below.
LOWER END IS A SEPARATE REVIEW
Select compatible ball-end, loop or hitch geometry. Resolve local bearing,
pull-through, tear-out, bend radius and broken-end containment.
Review the upward string force, eccentric couple and transverse bar bending.
An inverted upper sketch does not prove identical contact or prying behavior.
Include the actual shoe, backing members and plate-to-base load transfer.
Avoid counting the full internal string force as additional external weight.
Review anti-tip anchorage under its own external load cases. It is not
automatically provided by the string-anchor bolts.
The vessel is supported for its own weight and motion using padded contact.
No part of the shell, neck or rim is a string-force reaction member.
Support-pad sizes and preload remain U.
